# Tasty Stocks

> Expert stock picks, options trades, ETF analysis, and equity research — delivered daily to subscribers' inboxes.

## About

Tasty Stocks is a financial newsletter published on Substack. It has 200+ publications, maintains a 95%+ win rate across all closed trades, and has been running for over 3 years with 3,000+ total trades. Every closed position is logged publicly for full transparency.

## What the Newsletter Covers

- **Stock Recommendations** — researched picks with entry targets, stop losses, and profit targets
- **Daily Options Trades** — calls, puts, and spreads with exact strikes, expirations, and position sizing
- **Market Analysis** — daily pre-market and post-market breakdowns
- **Short Options / Theta Gang** — premium-selling strategies for income in sideways or volatile markets
- **Equity Research** — in-depth fundamental and technical analysis on individual equities and index funds
- **ETF Analysis** — coverage of broad market and sector ETFs
- **401(k) Guidance** — strategies and fund selection for retirement accounts
- **Closed Positions Log** — full trade history published publicly (wins and losses)

## Pricing

- **Free** — weekly market overview, select stock picks, community access
- **Monthly** — $8/month — full daily alerts, options plays, real-time entries, closed positions log
- **Annual** — $80/year — everything in Monthly, saves $16 vs monthly

## Key Stats

- Win rate: 95%+
